name: Vrang's Game
summary: Vrang sends you across a valley in the Barrens to check his traps. The small game they catch can help him, though other wildlife makes the area dangerous.

sections.title: Vrang's Traps
sections.body: Vrang has traps scattered across the valley, and he wants you to bring back any small game they have caught. Keep your attention on the wildlife too, for it can make the area dangerous.

faq.answer: Vrang wants you to check his traps and bring back any small game they have caught.
Vrang's traps are scattered across a valley in the Barrens.

faq.q: What is dangerous around the traps?
faq.answer: Other wildlife around the traps can be dangerous if you are not paying attention.
